items.title: Awesome Open Source Games
items.content_text:
### Browser-Based / Arcade

*   [SKALP (⭐0)](https://github.com/amudotcom-byte/skalp) - 60-second trading-floor reflex game. Go long or short, ride the chart, close before it reverses — and don't get liquidated.

### Native / Sandbox

*   [Blocks Beyond the Stars (⭐21)](https://github.com/marceld23/BlocksBeyondTheStars) - Block-based 3D space crafting sandbox with procedurally generated planets, block-by-block ship & base building and self-hostable multiplayer (Unity client, .NET server).

items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Development tools / Embedded

*   Development Tools
    *   [matheuswhite/scope-rs (⭐36)](https://github.com/matheuswhite/scope-rs) \[[scope-monitor](https://crates.io/crates/scope-monitor)] - Cross-platform serial-port & RTT monitor TUI with hex/@tag input macros, search, session recording, and Lua plugins. [![Build Status](https://github.com/matheuswhite/scope-rs/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/matheuswhite/scope-rs/actions)
    *   [probe-rs/probe-rs (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/probe-rs/probe-rs) \[[probe-rs-tools](https://crates.io/crates/probe-rs-tools)] - Embedded debugging toolkit for flashing and debugging ARM and RISC-V microcontrollers.
    *   [Vaishnav-Sabari-Girish/ComChan (⭐160)](https://github.com/Vaishnav-Sabari-Girish/ComChan) - A minimal serial monitor with plotter TUI.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [Pluribus (⭐7)](https://github.com/caioribeiroclw-pixel/pluribus) - Sync one canonical project context into native AI coding-agent rule files, including Gemini CLI `GEMINI.md`, Claude Code `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md`, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Amazon Q, Junie, Warp, Copilot, Windsurf, Continue, Zed, OpenCode, and OpenClaw.
